comments.author: Zeke
comments.content: Sounds cool! I probably won't be entering, though. However, I look forward to playing the winning game. How will the competition work? Will there be only one judge, or will there be many judges, or will the public vote? Will there be multiple rounds? Will people not involved be able to see the runners-up? So many questions!

comments.author: Alex Warren
comments.content:
The competition page has all the details - http://www.textadventures.co.uk/quest/competition/

I think Evan is currently looking for judges to volunteer, so there will be several. And all games entered will be available on the site.
